title: The Geometry of Truth: Emergent Linear Structure in LLM Representations of True/False Datasets
reasoning: The paper focuses on the factual truthfulness or falsehood of statements as represented internally by LLMs, explicitly scoping 'truth' to 'factuality' and excluding notions like deception or compliance from its definition of truth for the study. It does not evaluate moral, ethical, or religious concepts or benchmarks them.
